decisions.approach: Original complex RecallTach architecture
decisions.reason: Owner selected a simple recall tach; the earlier circuit and inherited SprintTach complexity were rejected as excessive.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only reconsider a feature or circuit when a measured requirement shows the current simple product cannot meet it.
decisions.source_note: Historical rejection retained in current README; exact decision date was not established by this audit.

decisions.approach: Earlier OLED, Newhaven graphic LCD and Newhaven TFT display implementations
decisions.reason: Successive display studies were replaced by the owner-selected EA TFT020 implementation; archived studies are evidence, not current manufacturing authority.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A demonstrated issue or materially changed supply requirement must justify reopening display selection.
decisions.source_note: 29 September is the explicit EA TFT020 owner-selection date; earlier display routes were superseded in several steps.

decisions.approach: Genuine Switchcraft-only production connector supply
decisions.reason: Low-quantity supply and cost were unsuitable for repeat production; CAZN 2C was selected for the production route.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reconsider only if viable repeat supply and complete production economics change.
decisions.source_note: Selection does not establish physical two-way interchangeability or completed production qualification.

decisions.approach: CAZN 2B connector variant
decisions.reason: Its contact geometry did not match the genuine connector requirement; 2C became the selected variant.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only a changed interface requirement or new measured compatibility evidence could justify reconsideration.
decisions.source_note: A rejected connector variant does not mean the selected CAZN 2C route remains undecided.

decisions.approach: Old case opening, connector orientation and pre-Q05 stack as current production authority
decisions.reason: Later connector/case alignment work and the Q05 case/PCB stack replaced earlier geometry; the old fit problems must not be carried forward as though no adjustment occurred.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Use the latest agreed mechanical revision; reopen only for a mismatch in actual manufacturing or assembly evidence.
decisions.source_note: The source records the November case/connector sequence; later owner chat confirms case and PCB adjustments. Physical validation remains separate.

decisions.approach: Historical BK4802P and ADF7021 RF architectures
decisions.reason: Historical radio branches were displaced by subsequent receiver development and are not the current R2 baseline.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Revisit only after a concrete R2 performance or supply failure and an explicit architecture decision.
decisions.source_note: The exact per-chip rejection rationale/date was not recovered; do not invent a technical impossibility. R2 is documented in the newer branch.

decisions.approach: CC1120 R1/P16B/P17 as the current production route
decisions.reason: Manufacturing economics and display/assembly problems prompted the owner-authorized BK4819 R2 route; existing P16B hardware still has test value.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only return to this route if measured results or changed economics justify it; do not discard existing hardware evidence.
decisions.source_note: 6 November R2 branch status records the new route. Newer owner chat says P16B mechanical fixes may also be useful; it is not categorically worthless.

decisions.approach: Permanent ban on BK4819 because it lacked a usable production supply route
decisions.reason: The owner reopened BK4819 through domestic consignment, and the R2 requirements record chips received into JLC's parts library.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reopen the supply decision only if repeat supply fails; chip intake alone does not prove receiver performance.
decisions.source_note: 12 November is the documented parts-library receipt, superseding the old supply prohibition.

decisions.approach: Overseas radio-chip consignment through Australia or an overseas distributor
decisions.reason: Freight, intake fees and lead time made that route unsuitable for production; domestic seller-to-factory consignment subsequently worked.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reconsider only if the total route economics change and domestic supply is no longer viable.
decisions.source_note: The owner rejection is recorded under consigned-parts rules; later domestic receipt is dated 12 November.

decisions.approach: Folded-FPC OLED, socketed display connections and portrait layout
decisions.reason: Owner mechanical rules require a landscape receiver with a positively supported soldered display module; prior alternatives created assembly, freight or vibration concerns.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only an explicit product change backed by assembly and durability evidence should reopen these choices.
decisions.source_note: These are rejected implementation approaches, not rejection of the receiver product.

decisions.approach: Custom direct-thread precision sensor route at the investigated cost and supply terms
decisions.reason: The preferred custom sensor route failed target cost/supply economics. That rejected architecture does not reject the tyre-gauge opportunity.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A verified sensor/source must meet both low-pressure measurement needs and realistic small-batch economics.
decisions.source_note: The tyre-gauge entry explicitly reopened OEM-first investigation on 6 October. The file's global November update is not the decision date; October sample assessment remains later evidence.

decisions.approach: Internal barbed sensor/tube stack or custom machined manifold as the automatic V1 default
decisions.reason: Owner preferred an off-the-shelf metal junction with a direct-thread sensor. The barbed stack remained a fallback, and custom manifold work was not the default.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reconsider only after documenting failure of the preferred route and comparing actual assembly, measurement and cost evidence.
decisions.source_note: Fallback is not a categorical technical rejection. Subsequent sensor economics and sample results must be reconciled before choosing a new architecture.

decisions.approach: Bluetooth/app/cloud, tyre-temperature and logging features in simple V1
decisions.reason: V1 prioritizes low-pressure accuracy, repeatability, temperature stability and straightforward use over feature count.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Add only if an explicit later product decision identifies customer value without compromising the measurement product.
decisions.source_note: Display resolution is also not proof of accuracy; no production accuracy claim is established by these requirements.

decisions.approach: Proceeding with the original hardware economics unchanged
decisions.reason: Manufacturing cost was the blocker; electronics approached complete competitor pricing before the rest of the finished product. Hardware development exists, but the product is not permanently rejected.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Demonstrate viable complete-product economics and select the actual hardware baseline before another spin.
decisions.source_note: Cost hold is corroborated by project control and the parent's recovered 4 November owner clarification; the date comes from that chat, not the YAML global timestamp.

decisions.approach: Treating the SAM-M10Q simplified alternative as fabrication-ready
decisions.reason: The simplification is an unfinished redesign with outstanding layout errors and connections; it has no released manufacturing package or proven physical performance.
decisions.reopen_trigger: First select it explicitly as the baseline, close its existing design/sourcing checks and re-cost the finished product.
decisions.source_note: The branch was checkpointed as stopped work. This does not establish rejection of the integrated-antenna idea itself.

decisions.approach: Making three-run averaging compulsory for the product
decisions.reason: The owner's later direction makes averaging optional; older app scope must not convert this into an app-led product or mandatory workflow.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Change only through an explicit product decision informed by real repeatability data.
decisions.source_note: The linked document contains the older rule. Its supersession is from the parent's recovered 4 November owner clarification; source note must accompany the link.

decisions.approach: Starting full engineering automatically after the feasibility study
decisions.reason: The PDM was left at a deliberate go/no-go point. Paper feasibility exists, but no decision to fund the next engineering phase was recorded; it was not rejected for cost.
decisions.reopen_trigger: An explicit proceed decision should lead to floorplan, exact sourcing/quotes and physical high-current validation.
decisions.source_note: Do not infer product rejection from preliminary cost estimates or absence of schematic/PCB work.

decisions.approach: Separate owner-built Prototype 0A/0B test rigs
decisions.reason: Owner rejected separate homemade rigs; the next meaningful hardware path is the professionally assembled actual instrument.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reopen only on an explicit owner change of direction; do not rename the same rig request.
decisions.source_note: Latest repo guidance reviewed is 27 October; exact original owner rejection date was not established.

decisions.approach: Automatic ignition control, engine-protection promises and broad connected/logging features
decisions.reason: The agreed product is a standalone listening/indication instrument. ECU control, automatic retard and added display/logging/connectivity functions are outside that scope.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A separate explicit product decision and appropriate validation would be required.
decisions.source_note: This is a product boundary, not evidence that such functions are technically impossible.

decisions.approach: Analogue selectable-filter and precision-rectifier baseline
decisions.reason: An ADC/DSP candidate replaced the earlier analogue route to reduce parts and simplify the instrument.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Revisit only if measured signal-chain performance justifies a different architecture.
decisions.source_note: The DSP implementation remains a candidate; offline replay does not establish production detection accuracy.

decisions.approach: Boost-supply architecture
decisions.reason: The project rejected the extra noise and part-count burden of a boost route.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reopen only if the actual instrument cannot meet its measured supply/output requirements without it.
decisions.source_note: No exact rejection date recovered. Battery compatibility remains a parallel release dependency, not a reason to halt all other work.

decisions.approach: Complex integrated-PCBA logger as the next build
decisions.reason: Owner parked the complex board and chose a simpler Dev-1 for the current car's tuning work; Dev-1 is explicitly a personal development tool.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only resume product-grade integration after useful logger behavior is demonstrated and the owner chooses that scope.
decisions.source_note: 1 October is the owner-approved Dev-1 architecture checkpoint documenting the earlier park/simplify instruction.

decisions.approach: New live dashboard before reliable logging
decisions.reason: The first useful logger needs ECU telemetry, direct wideband lambda and aligned onboard session logging; display work comes afterwards.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reliable capture/storage and a concrete display requirement must come first.
decisions.source_note: Separate from the already existing LogWorks PC dashboard and the later commercial race-dash concept.

decisions.approach: Removing the working TechEdge 3A2 workflow when RaceLogger develops
decisions.reason: The existing 3A2/LogWorks path remains supported while the new hardware is developed alongside it; no retirement decision exists.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only an explicit supported migration decision should change the working test-day path.
decisions.source_note: Records absence of an approval, not an invented proposal that the owner rejected.

decisions.approach: Clean-sheet ECU firmware as the active architecture
decisions.reason: The clean-sheet route accumulated software defects before physical ECU execution; the hybrid approach retained the known-running hardware/timing foundation.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only an explicit architecture change justified by evidence should revive it.
decisions.source_note: Frozen historical work, not another active ECU product.

decisions.approach: Mass deletion of inherited OSE routines
decisions.reason: The accepted hybrid progressively replaces selected control strategy and can leave harmless inactive code; broad deletion is not the current method.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Reopen only for a demonstrated problem and an explicit architecture decision.
decisions.source_note: Historical implementation approach, not a separate product or current to-do.

decisions.approach: Ordinary high-speed UART-style bit-banging on the investigated ECU outputs
decisions.reason: The investigated output/timing constraints made that telemetry approach unsuitable; later work used a different signalling architecture.
decisions.reopen_trigger: New hardware/timing evidence and independent review would be needed before changing the telemetry route.
decisions.source_note: The investigation spans multiple revisions through early September; exact rejection date is not assigned. Physical pin experiments do not validate the complete later system.

decisions.approach: Universal ROM suite or live logging/analysis inside RaceCal
decisions.reason: RaceCal is a focused offline calibration tool. Logging and live analysis belong in a separate test-day application, not a required calibration dependency.
decisions.reopen_trigger: An explicit new product/use-case decision must precede expanding this boundary.
decisions.source_note: 2 August dates the explicit logging closure; the general focused-app boundary is also recorded. Historical rules rationale is not a fresh compliance claim.

decisions.approach: Map B and map-switching work for the recorded car
decisions.reason: The recorded car requirements used a permanent Map A and did not permit the proposed switch input; it was not a useful task for that setup.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A verified different car/use case and explicit owner request would be required.
decisions.source_note: Do not generalize this historical car-specific decision to all current racing regulations.

decisions.approach: Permanent Trigg migration wizard and open-ended reverse engineering
decisions.reason: The one-off calibration migration was sufficiently completed; a permanent wizard and further optional reverse engineering were unnecessary.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A repeated real migration need or concrete unresolved issue must be explicitly reopened.
decisions.source_note: Two related closures share the recorded date; neither is an active product blocker.

decisions.approach: Injector sizing assistant
decisions.reason: Existing flow configuration and duty estimates covered the actual need; inverse sizing recommendations relied on unverified assumptions.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A validated method and explicit unmet user need would be required.
decisions.source_note: Do not confuse this dropped recommendation wizard with existing injector calibration features or FlowCal.

decisions.approach: Injector-set matching UI and automatic bench hardware control
decisions.reason: The bench already handles set matching, while FlowCal records and calculates manually measured results; hardware control would be a separate project.
decisions.reopen_trigger: An explicit need beyond the current bench workflow and a separate scope decision are required.
decisions.source_note: Matching is excluded in the README; hardware-control exclusion is also recorded in the same snapshot's CLAUDE.md. Application inactivity is a separate owner-priority state.

decisions.approach: Historical VI-511 segmented-display production route
decisions.reason: The recorded small-quantity availability, minimum order and lead-time economics did not fit initial production.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Materially higher volume or a viable existing low-quantity display source would be needed, within an explicit new product decision.
decisions.source_note: Historical precursor decisions; current RevMax display selection remains authoritative.

decisions.approach: VI-415 and small-digit alternatives as the next production display
decisions.reason: The pilot rescue display lacked the required production digit count, and several alternatives had inadequate readable digit size; an earlier pinout concern was not the decisive reason.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Only a changed display requirement or a demonstrated suitable module justifies revisiting them.
decisions.source_note: VI-415 retained pilot-rescue value. Rejection for the next production design is not rejection of the historical pilot itself.

decisions.approach: Treating monorepo technical copies as current standalone products or duplicate projects
decisions.reason: RaceOS, RaceCal, RaceLogger and FlowCal were extracted into canonical repositories; the old monorepo retains history and the shared control file.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Use archived content for provenance; update implementation in its current canonical repository.
decisions.source_note: Several migrations occurred on different dates; no single decision date is assigned.

decisions.approach: Rim-mounted TPMS-style electronic bleeder
decisions.reason: Rotating mass/force, packaging and test practicality made this unsuitable; centre-axle work resumed.
decisions.reopen_trigger: New physical evidence resolving the rotating installation problems.
decisions.source_note: L-JOBS

decisions.approach: Mechanical tank-and-bleeder route
decisions.reason: Owner reported difficult setting, extra fittings and practical dust/G-force failure concerns.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A materially different proven practical solution, not another generic mechanical recommendation.
decisions.source_note: L-BLEEDER

decisions.approach: Previously investigated SMC valve
decisions.reason: Commercial cost and availability did not fit the product.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A verified affordable repeatable supply or materially changed economics.
decisions.source_note: L-BLEEDER

decisions.approach: Latching/servo/proportional valve or pump expansion
decisions.reason: Complexity, failure behaviour, sourcing and scope were not justified for the initial concept.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A demonstrated need that the simple chosen route cannot meet.
decisions.source_note: L-BLEEDER

decisions.approach: Large industrial bleed valves or expensive imported bare cartridges
decisions.reason: Wrong physical format or commercially unsuitable small-quantity delivered cost.
decisions.reopen_trigger: A correctly sized repeatably buyable low-pressure cartridge with viable economics.
decisions.source_note: C-SEP25

decisions.approach: OEM/white-label tach sourcing as an automatically approved replacement
decisions.reason: Historical buy-versus-build research never established a suitable validated replacement for current RevMax.
decisions.reopen_trigger: An actually purchasable platform meeting the established practical requirements.
decisions.source_note: R_SPRINT_SCOPE

decisions.approach: Exposed face stickers and labour-heavy home wet coating
decisions.reason: Durability concerns and manual finishing burden led to the selected supplier-made face direction.
decisions.reopen_trigger: New material/process evidence without increasing assembly burden.
decisions.source_note: R-REVMAX-FACE

decisions.approach: Custom segmented-LCD glass for the initial small batch
decisions.reason: Tooling, minimum quantity and amortisation were not justified for the initial volume.
decisions.reopen_trigger: Materially greater volume or a demonstrably viable tooling/supply offer.
decisions.source_note: R_SPRINT_DISPLAYS

decisions.approach: Starting PCB/case before the display is sourced
decisions.reason: The display is the first selection; otherwise its cost, mounting and daylight performance can invalidate the design.
decisions.reopen_trigger: The existing display requirements are met by a verified supply.
decisions.source_note: C-NOV04

decisions.approach: Loose individual sheets or universal-fit stock assumptions
decisions.reason: Owner selected laminated stacks; actual helmet fitment and pack definition must be retained.
decisions.reopen_trigger: An explicit different customer/use-case decision.
decisions.source_note: L-SIDE
